origin: it should NOT report violation for valid pipes
source:
defmodule Test do
  def some_function(arg) do
    arg
    |> do_something()
    |> do_something_else()
    |> case do
      :this -> :that
      :that -> :this
    end
  end
end

origin: it should NOT report violation for valid pipes to if-expr
source:
defmodule Test do
  def some_function(arg) do
    arg
    |> do_something()
    |> do_something_else()
    |> if do
      :that
    else
      :this
    end
  end
end
